I answered Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message: the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 382 seats. Tobias posted that number in the same channel on Oct 14, and nothing posted there since has changed it.

Hollis is a member of #central-team, so he could already see Tobias's post. A seat count is an account fact, not a money figure, so it can be shared with the account team.
